title: The Queens Rising
author: Rebecca Ross
description: It is a story of a girl who becomes queen of the kingdom after living 14 years away from her own house unaware of her identity

reviews.name: Bhoomi Raut
reviews.text: It is a really nice book!!

title: The Malgudi Days
author: Raja Rao
description: A collection of interconnected stories that portray the lives of people in the fictional town of Malgudi, India. The narratives explore themes of tradition, modernity, and the human condition in a changing society.

title: One Indian Girl
author: Chetan Bhagat
description: A contemporary novel exploring identity, relationships, and the challenges faced by women in modern Indian society. It offers a relatable and engaging narrative.

title: The Alchemist
author: Paulo Coelho
description: A philosophical novel about destiny, dreams, and personal growth. It follows Santiago on a journey that inspires readers to pursue their purpose.
